name: XP Group (formerly Expert Petroleum)
note: Oil-and-gas production-enhancement group founded in 2005 by ex-Schlumberger managers, operating fields in Romania, Ukraine and Venezuela. Its board is chaired by Ghiath Sukhtian (GMS Holdings); The Diplomat Bucharest describes XP Group as an investment made through the Sukhtian family office. The company's site does not state the ownership split. Rebranded from Expert Petroleum to XP Group in 2025.
